purpose: Evidence for the Index Exile markers (index_exile) on the seven active tickers that have no tracked-index tag after the 2026-10-05 tag refresh. Owner's rule: a ticker that was in the S&P 500, S&P 100, NASDAQ-100 or DJIA and has left all of them stays active and scored daily; it is grouped as an Index Exile and counts in no index. Dates are the index change effective dates from the change tables below; nothing is guessed.

changes.reason: Walmart transferred its listing from NYSE to Nasdaq and replaced AstraZeneca; AstraZeneca was preparing to move its listing to the NYSE.

AZN.universe_tag_history: universe.json tags: NASDAQ-100 since 2026-05-17 (commit 218e67bf); removed by the tag refresh (commit ca7b42fa, _index_tag_report.json). Never tagged S&P 500 (foreign-domiciled).

GFS.universe_tag_history: universe.json tags: NASDAQ-100 since 2026-05-17 (commit 218e67bf); removed by the tag refresh (commit ca7b42fa, _index_tag_report.json). Never tagged S&P 500 (foreign-domiciled).
GFS.note: The universe kept a stale NASDAQ-100 tag from 2026-05-17 until 2026-10-05; GFS had left the index on 2025-12-22.

LCID.universe_tag_history: universe.json tags: added 2026-05-17 (commit 218e67bf, scripts/lthcs_build_universe.py hand list); S&P 500 tag removed by the S&P 500 sync (commit 6dbf23cc, data/lthcs/universe_candidate/sp500_2026-10-05/_sync_report.json); NASDAQ-100 tag removed by the tag refresh (commit ca7b42fa, _index_tag_report.json).
LCID.note: The universe's NASDAQ-100 tag was already stale when it was added on 2026-05-17 (LCID left on 2023-12-18). The universe's former 'S&P 500' tag was inferred by scripts/lthcs_build_universe.py (NASDAQ-100 name not in NDX_NOT_IN_SPX => S&P 500), not sourced; the S&P 500 change history (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Historical_components_of_the_S%26P_500 (revision 1376064088)) has no row for this ticker, so S&P 500 is not a former index.
